reaction_endpoint_contract.initial_state: an adsorbed, intact Li2S state on the named host
reaction_endpoint_contract.final_state: the agent's explicitly defined adsorbed decomposition product state with the same atoms and charge
reaction_endpoint_contract.barrier: maximum energy along the validated minimum-energy path minus the submitted initial-state energy
reaction_endpoint_contract.energies: report electronic barrier in eV; if thermal corrections are used, report them separately
reaction_endpoint_contract.surface_search: use low-index cleavage-stable surfaces derivable from the ICSD records; document all tested terminations and retain one uniquely identified model per host for the primary comparison

known_physical_boundary.neutrality: preserve total charge unless a justified alternative is reported
